question:
Select the most appropriate collocation to fill in the blank.

Ujjwal was imprisoned for ________ a crime.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**committing**" means to carry out or perpetrate (a mistake, crime, or immoral act). (अपराध करना)
 
• In the context of the sentence, **"committing"** is the right collocation to use with the word "crime."
 
• The other options such as "**making**," "**undertaking**, " and "**involving**" do not fit the context as appropriately as "committing."

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Ujjwal was imprisoned for committing__ a crime.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Making (बनाना)**: means to create, form, or construct something.
 
• **Undertaking (प्रयास)**: means to take on a responsibility or a task.
 
• **Involving (शामिल होना)**: means to include or engage in an activity or situation.
